layout_sources: https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/tree/main/ca/tangerine (2022: header row, m/d/Y, Date, Transaction, Name, Memo, Amount)

https://www.mrexcel.com/board/threads/solution-mixed-up-day-month-order-on-data-exports.1226240/ (a Tangerine CSV whose m/d/yyyy dates Excel swapped; types OTHER, FEE, ATM, CREDIT; "INTERAC e-Transfer To:" names)
https://github.com/firefly-iii/firefly-iii/issues/3945 (a Tangerine Mastercard file 01-tangerineMC.csv with Transaction date,Transaction,Name,Memo,Amount)
notes: Header Date,Transaction,Name,Memo,Amount (the Mastercard download says "Transaction date"). M/D/YYYY without leading zeros. Transaction is Tangerine's type (DEBIT, CREDIT, OTHER, FEE, ATM); Name the payee or what it was; Memo a second line, often empty. One signed amount, money out negative, no thousands separator. No balance. Newest first, LF, unquoted fields and the file name are assumed; the Name and Memo wording is invented in Tangerine's style.
